observations: The +42 shift at con_table comes from the 101-byte diagnostic interval versus a 59-byte target interval after the same preceding BIOS error routine.
The clock entry wrapper occurs at target file offset 0x279f, while the CONFIG table appears at 0x4990; those diagnostic contributions are not at their target positions.
The target 59-byte interval contains the historical four printer wait-count words and month-length table by byte pattern; this does not by itself establish ownership or all symbol names.
limitations: Only selected boundary and content signatures were compared; complete code and relocated pointers remain unverified.
The interval size difference alone does not prove a unique reordering or identity of every byte.
